title: Tiny Room Map · Pair relay
hook: Find a game, gather your friends and start playing.

knows: The group wants an activity to play together.
doesNotKnow: The setup, turn and ending for this house-rule format.

misconception: The group has to know a complicated rulebook before starting.
objective: Learn how to play Tiny Room Map · Pair relay with friends.

claims.text: Original house rules: Choose a familiar room and three visible objects in it. The lead sketches a top-down map with symbols for the objects. A partner identifies the room and all three objects on the map. Form pairs. On each pair’s turn, both people make separate attempts with fresh challenges, helping only their partner. The pair earns one point only if both succeed. Each pair has two turns. Highest score wins.
claims.source: Original playable house-rule proposal; not an authoritative ruleset for a traditional game.

claims.text: For this version: 4, 6 or 8 players; materials: Paper and pencil.
claims.source: Proposed setup and player range for this activity.

recall.question: In Tiny Room Map, what counts as a successful turn?
options: The group ends the round before anyone plays.
A partner identifies the room and all three objects on the map.
The lead skips the turn without attempting it.
recall.why: A partner identifies the room and all three objects on the map.
